newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil edges higher on IPE futures gains.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil edges higher on IPE futures gains.

text.p: NWE gas oil edged slightly higher on Thursday in line with futures gains and slightly firmer premiums, traders said.
July gas oil was trading 75 cents higher at $161.00 a tonne.
Heating oil barge premiums crept back into positive territory even though buyers continued to put in negative bids.
A small parcel of heating oil material traded at July IPE flat fob Rotterdam for delivery into July.
"It's pretty quiet but there are a few more enquiries," said trader.
Premiums were quoted around July IPE -25 cents/+25 cents fob for prompt, and July IPE -25 cents/+50 cents fob ARA.
There was little talk on the diesel barge front with premiums talked around July IPE +$4.50/+$5.50 fob ARA.
Heating oil cargoes were little changed with talk of Russian material quoted at around July IPE -50 cents/+50 cents cif NWE.

EN590 premiums were little changed at around July IPE +$6.0/+$7.0 cif NWE. Traders said little had been done since the raft of deals at the beginning of the week at levels ranging July IPE +$5.50/+$6.50 cif NWE.
